column3: The rule validator takes null as unset (opt(nullable(int))) and the client drops nulls when it parses rules (ruleOf), so a batching webhook can be edited and rotated
column4: The server's view fills unset rule fields with null and its own validator refused them, so every rule without all three timers failed edit and rotate with bad_args. Fixed at both ends, so agent and API clients that echo a view also work
